output: Scientific Hypothesis: There is no significant relationship between income and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset. The analysis used logistic regression with income (INCOME) as the predictor variable and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings (SAMESAVE) as the response variable. The coefficient for income was approximately -0.0056, and the calculated p-value was approximately 1.99, which is not statistically significant (p > 0.05). This suggests that income does not have a significant impact on the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings in this dataset.
